info.description: End-to-end tests for Customers, Accounts, the Audit Trail, Registration/Login and permissions. Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner; folder 0 logs in as admin and every request uses that token unless it sets its own. adminUsername/adminPassword must match ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD in the API's .env. Each request saves the IDs the later ones need, and the run deletes everything it created.
